letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, and your smile lights up my world brighter than the desert sun. Today feels like a gentle whisper of spring, urging me to tell you again how deeply I love you, my cutie. No matter where we are, my heart beats only for you—forever yours, now and always.
poem:
In deserts gold or monsoon rain,  
Your love’s the rhythm, sweet refrain.  
Through miles we dance, hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, sweet Liza, mine.
